deathSays.line: You wake up with dirt in your mouth and blood on your hands that isn't yours. The sky is the wrong color — not sunset-wrong, wound-wrong. Enzo Kaiser. Blacksmith. From Columbus, Ohio. That was yesterday. This is now. You have: Trail compass, Carpenter's square, Grandfather's Rope, Lucky Coin, Dead Phone. That's everything you own in this world. Haven. Twelve people. The fire is lit. Last night, something walked past the treeline on two legs. Too tall. It stopped. It listened. Then it kept going. Nobody slept after that.

tableLines.line: The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Herve speaks at Stonebridge's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.
SYSTEM: Neural interface stable. Text overlay enabled.
"Your understanding is... deepening! We can see it! Like watching a seed decide to be a tree! Beautiful! Profitable!"
👂 Overheard — Roberto (to Gunther): "Ines's story has a fresh coat of paint." Roberto taps the table. "Scrape it off and you get a florist. Just don't scrape it in front of them."
📖 Codex: Nibble Tide — locks onto one target — moving won't dodge it. You won't forget this.
📖 Codex: Swarm Hum — hits everything close around it. You won't forget this.

The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Herve speaks at Emberhold's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.

📓 Codex: Emberhold split (cannibal). The Red Table formed; 2 petition at Haven's fire.
🧳 Emberhold has split — the eaters walked. They call the new fire The Red Table. Half of them were headed this way, or so the traveler says.
💔 A faction of Stonebridge has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table II is a new fire in the world now — 2 people under Tariq.

FUSION REACTOR: the pellet goes in — properly, inside you. A warm hum starts behind your ribs and settles. You will never be hungry again. One reactor per world: yours. It does not come out. (The System is DELIGHTED. That should worry you.)

✨ Ability gained: Fusion Reactor (L1). The System installs your fusion pellet — properly, inside you. You never need to eat again: the pellet covers your metabolism, and your strikes and abilities burn with a steady reactor fire (1.25x, always on). One reactor per world, and it never comes out: not unslotted, not un-taught, not surrendered. Death is the only uninstall. But the hunger is gone, and with it the joy: food gives you no morale, feasts give you no comfort, and your fire never burns hotter than this. A cold spot at every table.

📨 Word came: Nathan Lee of The Red Table II wants to join Haven. "My village is gone. Yours isn't. That's the whole of it." — they haven't set foot here. The village will judge.

◈ THE TABLE — the ring of pale light flickers at the edge of the sky... and does not come. Not yet. The table is being set for those whose deeds are done, and yours are not done. The ledger still wants: the food-thesis deeds. The climb is not over.

📖 Codex: Director's Cut — strikes in a straight line. You won't forget this.
The table is being set — a lesser seat, priced for what you built. They are watching to see who comes to it.

◈ THE TABLE — it is not a table. It's a ring of pale light, and around it, things with too many angles to be faces. Above it all — the audience. Trillions of eyes, and every one of them knows your name. The System speaks, and for once it isn't performing: "HUMANITY PRESENTS ITS CASE."

◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — regional standing, waves 1–3 faced (19/11/4), with 5 wave-4 and 3 wave-5 fought, 12 contests survived, 3 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices.
The table has read your ledger. The protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared. The light road is open.
You won. Say it plainly: you won. The village endures. The table signed. The galaxy applauds, and the applause is real, and you earned it.
